data.name: Mirah
data.gender_notes: Mirah is used as a unisex name in Islamic naming traditions.
data.long_meaning: Derived from the Arabic root 'R-H-M', which means 'to love' and 'to guide'. In Islamic tradition, Mirah signifies the light of guidance provided by Allah and the prophets. It is a reminder of the spiritual journey towards the true path and the importance of staying focused and steadfast. The name Mirah carries the meaning “Guiding Light” and is chosen by families in Islamic traditions for the positive qualities it expresses. Linguistically it belongs to the Arabic tradition and is also used in Arabic, Urdu, Persian. Parents who choose Mirah usually hope their child will grow to embody guiding light and live with faith, good character and purpose.
data.spiritual_meaning: Symbol of guidance and enlightenment in the Islamic faith.
data.etymology: Mirah belongs to the Arabic linguistic tradition and is used in Islamic naming. Its recorded meaning is “Guiding Light.”
data.numerology_meaning: In Pythagorean numerology the letters of Mirah total 4, giving a life-path number of 4. Number 4 is linked with Rahu and with the qualities of stability, discipline and hard work.
